job.title: Project Manager / Business Analyst
job.description:
About the Company

Davidson Technology are working with a State Government Department to secure an experienced Project manager / Business Analyst to work within the Privileged Access Management team.


About the Role

As the Project Manager / Business Analyst, you will lead the day-to-day coordination and business analysis activities for the production implementation of Keeper Privileged Access Management (PAM). You will be responsible for establishing and maintaining the integrated project plan, schedule, budget, governance, procurement activities, risks, issues and dependencies, while coordinating delivery across multiple specialist technology and cyber security teams. Alongside your project management responsibilities, you will gather and document business, technical, security and operational requirements, develop process flows and acceptance criteria, and ensure requirements remain traceable to agreed project outcomes. You will drive stakeholder actions and decisions, coordinate testing, defect resolution, assurance and reporting, and manage readiness for the production pilot. A key focus will be bringing the various technical workstreams together without taking over their platform accountability, ensuring training, communications, operational documentation, support arrangements and knowledge transfer are completed so the Keeper PAM solution can be successfully accepted and transitioned into BAU.


About You

To be successful, you will bring a minimum of seven years’ experience delivering projects within large-scale ICT environments, with demonstrated success managing complex infrastructure, identity, cyber security or enterprise platform implementations through to production and operational acceptance. You will combine strong project management capability across planning, scheduling, budgets, procurement, governance, RAID, dependencies and executive reporting with hands-on business analysis experience encompassing requirements elicitation, process mapping, acceptance criteria, traceability, testing support and operational readiness. You will have experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams and vendors, ideally across cyber security, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Identity and Access Management (IAM) or Essential Eight initiatives, and a sound understanding of enterprise technologies including Linux, Windows Server, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, networking and high-availability environments. You will be confident navigating organisational financial, procurement, security and change controls, coordinating vendor delivery and licensing, and producing concise, evidence-based executive, assurance, milestone and financial reporting. Your ability to build strong relationships and translate effectively between business, operational, security and highly technical stakeholders will enable you to drive actions and decisions through to closure, while your experience coordinating production implementation, testing, change, training, knowledge transfer and BAU handover will ensure solutions are successfully transitioned into operation. Relevant project management and business analysis certifications are highly regarded, while previous experience with Keeper PAM or another privileged access management platform will be advantageous.


The Benefits

You will be offered a 6-month contract on an excellent hourly rate and the ability to negotiate a flexible working arrangement for the duration of the assignment.

job.title: SAP Solution Architect
job.description:

As the Solution Architect, you will provide architectural leadership and expert advice across the design, development, integration and ongoing enhancement of enterprise solutions, ensuring technology outcomes align with business requirements and organisational strategy. You will analyse business requirements and system specifications, develop solution architecture and detailed design documentation, and ensure solutions comply with relevant technical strategies, standards, policies, governance and cyber security requirements. You will work closely with business owners, technical teams, project teams, vendors and other stakeholders to define and deliver agreed outcomes, while providing expert advice and quality assurance across key project deliverables. About You

You will bring strong knowledge across SAP finance and supply chain domains, including General Ledger, Asset Accounting, Accounts Payable and Receivable, Management Accounting and Budgeting, Asset Management, Real Estate, Inventory Management, Operational Procurement and Extended Warehouse Management. You will have significant architectural experience developing integration strategies, solution architectures and Solution Integration Designs, with the ability to translate complex SAP technical concepts into practical solutions that achieve business outcomes. You will be experienced in developing and presenting high-quality architectural and solution artefacts and working across multiple technical and business teams to maintain an integrated end-to-end solution. About the Company

Working within the client's multidisciplinary design team, you’ll translate operational, user and technical requirements into secure, resilient and scalable network solutions. You’ll take ownership of defined work packages across the full project lifecycle - from early concepts and detailed design through procurement, construction, commissioning and operational readiness.

This is an opportunity to combine hands-on network engineering with client-facing consulting, contributing to sophisticated environments where performance, reliability and event-day readiness are essential.

The role may be based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane, with some project-related travel required.

About You

You’re an experienced network engineer who enjoys turning complex requirements into practical, well-coordinated solutions. You’re confident managing your own deliverables, working directly with clients and collaborating across technical and design disciplines.

You bring strong engineering judgement, attention to detail and the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You’ll Bring

  • At least five years’ experience in network design, engineering or technology consulting, with increasing responsibility.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise routing, switching, wireless networking, IP addressing, VLANs, redundancy, QoS, multicast, monitoring and network security.
  • Demonstrated experience producing network designs, technical specifications, schematics, schedules and reports across multiple project stages.
  • Experience working on complex venues, buildings, campuses, transport, infrastructure or similarly integrated technology projects.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification in engineering, information technology, telecommunications or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Strong written, verbal and visual communication skills, with confidence contributing to client workshops and design meetings.
  • Australian working rights and the flexibility to attend project sites and travel when required.

Professional-level certifications such as Cisco CCNP, Aruba ACSP/ACMP or Juniper JNCIP would be highly regarded. Experience with high-density Wi-Fi, network access control, software-defined networking, cloud-managed networks or converged technologies such as AV-over-IP, IPTV, broadcast and electronic security would also be valuable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop LAN, WAN, WLAN and data centre or communications-room architectures across concept, schematic and detailed design stages.
  • Prepare logical and physical network designs covering topology, redundancy, routing and switching, addressing, segmentation, security, QoS and network management.
  • Design networks supporting converged services such as corporate ICT, building systems, AV-over-IP, IPTV, broadcast, security, ticketing, point-of-sale, voice and venue operations.
  • Produce technical specifications, network schematics, connectivity diagrams, rack elevations, equipment schedules, bandwidth assessments and design reports.
  • Coordinate network requirements with structured cabling, wireless, cybersecurity, audiovisual, security, broadcast, electrical and architectural disciplines.
  • Evaluate vendor solutions and recommend fit-for-purpose technologies based on interoperability, lifecycle, supportability, sustainability and whole-of-life value.
  • Facilitate requirements workshops and design meetings with clients, venue operators, consultants, contractors and technology vendors.
  • Review tenders, contractor proposals, shop drawings, product submissions and technical departures against the approved design intent.
  • Respond to technical queries during construction and undertake site inspections, testing, commissioning and operational-readiness activities.
  • Manage assigned work packages to agreed quality, programme and budget expectations.
  • Contribute to technical standards, design tools, peer reviews and the development of graduate and junior engineers.

  • Experience delivering complex digital health projects
  • Strong project governance, risk, vendor and stakeholder management capability
  • Excellent written communication and executive reporting skills

Experience with payroll processing is essential, along with the usual traits that all great payroll people have – high level attention to detail, timeliness, clear communication, strong customer service skills and patience.


The Benefits

  • 76-hour fortnight, worked over 9 or 10 days
  • 3 days per week in office - every Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday
  • CBD & Eight Mile Plains office locations
  • Salary equivalent to $100 000 plus super when using salary packaging benefits
  • Paid overtime
  • Start between 7.30am and 8.30am daily

job.title: Solution Architect
job.description:
About the Company

Join a large, purpose-driven organisation operating within the healthcare sector, currently undertaking a significant digital transformation to modernise its technology landscape and improve the delivery of services across Australia.

With a complex mix of cloud, SaaS and enterprise applications, the organisation is investing in creating a more connected, scalable and sustainable technology environment.


About the Role

We are seeking an Azure Integration Solution Architect to take ownership of integration architecture across a major healthcare digital transformation program.


Working alongside an established Dynamics 365 specialist, internal technology teams and a strategic delivery partner, you will focus on how Dynamics 365 and other enterprise platforms connect across the broader technology landscape.


You will design and govern integration solutions using the Microsoft Azure integration stack, including Logic Apps, Service Bus, API Management and Power Automate. A key focus will be identifying integration gaps across applications and vendors, establishing reusable integration patterns, and ensuring solutions are secure, resilient and maintainable.


You will also provide architectural oversight of vendor designs, support delivery teams through build and implementation, and ensure integration decisions align with both immediate program requirements and the organisation's longer-term technology strategy.

About You

You will be an experienced Integration or Solution Architect with strong technical depth across Microsoft Azure and complex enterprise integration environments.

You will ideally bring:

  • Strong Azure integration architecture experience, particularly Logic Apps, Service Bus and API Management
  • Experience with Power Automate and the broader Microsoft ecosystem
  • Strong knowledge of APIs, messaging, event-driven architecture and enterprise integration patterns
  • Experience integrating cloud, SaaS and legacy enterprise applications
  • Exposure to Dynamics 365 and Dataverse integrations, without needing to be a D365 specialist
  • Experience designing secure, scalable and resilient integration solutions
  • Strong architecture governance and technical design capabilities
  • Experience working across large digital transformation programs involving multiple systems and vendors
  • Confidence reviewing and challenging architecture produced by systems integrators and delivery partners
  • Strong stakeholder management skills across technical and business teams
  • Azure certifications will be highly regarded
  • Previous experience within healthcare or similarly complex, highly regulated environments will be advantageous.

Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Dylan Tasker on dylan.tasker@davidsonwp.com , quoting reference JN -092026-44275. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Workforce Planning & Operations Manager
job.description:
Help shape the future of a growing disability services organisation where people genuinely come first.


At Elevate Disability, they are passionate about delivering disability support differently.

Founded by leaders who started their careers as support workers, Elevate was built on a simple belief: people living with disability deserve individualised support delivered with compassion, respect and genuine care.

What began with a single participant has grown into a thriving organisation supporting individuals, families and communities across South East Queensland. Despite this growth, they've remained committed to the values that inspired our journey from day one - putting people before profit, building meaningful relationships and creating positive outcomes for every participant they support.

As they continue to grow, they are seeking a Workforce Planning & Operations Manager to help shape the next stage of our journey.


About the Role

This newly created leadership role will play a critical part in ensuring our workforce, systems and operational structures continue to support exceptional participant outcomes as the organisation expands.

Working closely with the founders and leadership team, you'll lead workforce planning initiatives, improve operational efficiency and help develop scalable workforce models that support both sustainable growth and high quality service delivery.

You'll bring structure, insight and strategic thinking to workforce operations while maintaining a strong focus on the people at the heart of everything they do.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading workforce planning and workforce optimisation initiatives
  • Developing workforce models that support participant needs and organisational growth
  • Forecasting workforce demand, capacity and resource requirements
  • Identifying opportunities to improve workforce utilisation and operational performance
  • Supporting workforce capability, succession planning and future growth initiatives
  • Using workforce and operational data to support decision making
  • Partnering with leaders across the organisation to drive continuous improvement
  • Contributing to strategic planning and organisational development initiatives


About You

You are a commercially minded operational leader who understands that workforce planning is ultimately about people.

To really excel in this role, you will have experience in workforce planning, operations management, service delivery leadership in a similar role within disability, community services, healthcare or aged care

Most importantly, you'll be someone who:

  • Builds strong relationships and earns trust quickly
  • Thinks strategically while remaining practical and hands on
  • Enjoys solving complex workforce and operational challenges
  • Uses data and insight to inform decisions
  • Leads with empathy, integrity and accountability
  • Shares our commitment to delivering outstanding outcomes for participants


Why Join Elevate Disability?

Culture isn't something they talk about occasionally - it's how they operate every day.

The leadership team remains highly involved in the business and understands first hand the realities of frontline support. They invest heavily in our people, prioritise wellbeing and work hard to create an environment where employees feel valued, supported and connected.

You'll enjoy:

  • A genuine values led culture
  • Direct access to founders and senior leaders
  • The opportunity to shape a growing organisation
  • Ongoing professional development and career growth
  • New modern office in Cleveland with onsite parking
  • Collaborative workspaces and outdoor wellness areas designed for staff wellbeing
  • The chance to make a meaningful impact in the lives of people living with disability

If you're looking for a role where your work will influence both organisational success and participant outcomes, I’d love to hear from you.

Please apply with current resume in Microsoft Word format only (.doc or .docx). If you would like to have a confidential discussion, please contact Catherine Lyttle, quoting reference JN -092026-44268.

Want to know more about Davidson? Visit us at www.davidsonwp.com

job.title: Agile Delivery Lead
job.description:
About the Company

Davidson has partnered with Barwon Water to appoint an Agile Delivery Lead to play a pivotal role in driving the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives across the organisation.

About the Role

We're seeking an experienced Agile Delivery Lead to support a major Asset Management transformation program focused on improving the way field operations, work management, inventory, and warehouse functions operate across the business. This role will sit at the intersection of business transformation, operational technology, and delivery leadership, driving Agile ways of working across teams responsible for field workforce management, work order execution, maintenance operations, inventory management, and warehouse processes.

  • Lead Agile delivery across Asset Management and operational business functions.
  • Drive adoption of Agile ways of working across technology and business teams.
  • Facilitate planning, prioritisation, delivery governance, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Work closely with stakeholders responsible for:
    • Field Workforce Management
    • Work Order Management
    • Maintenance Operations
    • Asset Lifecycle Management
    • Inventory Management
    • Warehouse Operations
  • Coach teams, Product Owners, and business leaders in Agile delivery practices.
  • Manage delivery roadmaps, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Support the successful delivery of initiatives relating to Enterprise Asset Management systems and operational processes.
  • Establish meaningful reporting, delivery metrics, and visibility across programs of work.
  • Act as the bridge between operational business users and technology delivery teams.

About You

  • Proven experience as an Agile Delivery Lead, Delivery Manager, Agile Coach, or Program Delivery Lead.
  • Strong experience delivering transformation initiatives within Asset Management.
  • Experience working with:
    • Field Management solutions
    • Work Order Management systems
    • Maintenance Management platforms
    • Inventory and Warehouse Management functions
  • Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills.
  • Experience implementing and embedding Agile delivery practices across multiple teams.
  • Ability to lead delivery while remaining hands-on and outcome-focused.
  • IBM Maximo experience.
  • Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) platform experience.
  • Jira and Agile reporting/dashboard experience.
  • Agile certifications such as Scrum Master, SAFe, ICAgile or equivalent.

Experience with IBM Maximo is highly desirable. Candidates with strong exposure to SAP, ERP platforms, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) systems, logistics, supply chain, inventory, or warehouse management solutions will also be considered.

The Benefits

This is an opportunity to join an organisation undertaking one of regional Victoria's most significant transformation agendas while playing a key leadership role in shaping delivery capability and performance. You'll work closely with senior leaders, product teams, technology specialists and delivery partners while contributing to initiatives that will create lasting value for Barwon Water and the communities it serves.




Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Maaz Mian on Maaz.Mian@Davidsonwp.com, quoting reference JN -092026-44230. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Deputy Chief Operating Officer
job.description:
• Lead Accommodation and Social Connections across Australia’s largest not-for-profit disability service provider
  • Drive financial discipline, operational excellence and sustainable service delivery that supports quality outcomes for clients
  • Support leadership capability, accountability and ways of working across a large, geographically dispersed service network

Scope is Australia’s largest not-for-profit disability service provider, delivering services including supported independent living, short-term accommodation, social connections and therapy across Victoria and New South Wales. Scope has managed revenue of $510M and employs circa 6200 personnel across 400 service locations. At Scope, we create meaningful opportunities for people with disability to belong and thrive. Our clients and employees are empowered to live their dreams while we influence and push boundaries to deliver positive change for people with disability. Operating in a complex and evolving NDIS environment, Scope continues to strengthen how services are delivered, with a focus on operational excellence, quality and safeguarding, financial sustainability and positive outcomes for clients.

We are seeking an accomplished senior operational leader to join Scope as Deputy Chief Operating Officer – Accommodation & Social Connections. Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the role will lead Scope’s Accommodation and Social Connections divisions, with responsibility for a portfolio of approximately $420 million and six direct reports. As Scope continues to evolve its operating model, this role will have a strong focus on financial discipline, ways of working and leadership accountability, while embedding continuous improvement and operational excellence across Accommodation and Social Connections.

Building on work already underway, the Deputy COO will provide the visible leadership and drive required to embed these foundations across capability, culture and ways of working. This will position Accommodation and Social Connections to further evolve practice leadership, supervision and person-centred supports.

A key focus will be improving performance across occupancy, utilisation, cost-to-serve, profitability and salary-to-revenue, alongside client retention, service quality and safeguarding outcomes. The Deputy COO will bring strong financial and operational discipline to the portfolio, ensuring resources are effectively deployed and services remain sustainable within the changing NDIS environment.

Working closely with leaders across Operations, including Head of Client Growth and General Manager Operations Enablement, the Deputy COO will also support client acquisition and retention, reduce vacancy fill times and improve capacity utilisation across both divisions.

We are seeking a senior leader who has a demonstrated history of:

  • Lead large-scale service delivery across a complex and geographically dispersed environment
  • Bring strong financial and commercial discipline to operational decision-making
  • Improve occupancy, utilisation, cost-to-serve and overall portfolio performance
  • Progress operating models and translate strategy into sustainable operational delivery
  • Embed continuous improvement and operational excellence across services
  • Strengthen leadership capability, accountability and ways of working enhancing client and team experience
  • Lead quality, safeguarding, risk and regulatory performance within operations
  • Use data and evidence to drive service planning, prioritisation and performance improvement
  • Engage and influence effectively across Executive, operational and stakeholder environments.

The successful candidate will bring extensive operational leadership experience gained within disability services, human services or another complex and highly regulated service environment. They will bring strong commercial and financial acumen, experience leading significant service delivery operations and the ability to create clarity, accountability and momentum across large and dispersed teams.

This is an opportunity to lead two significant service portfolios within Scope and play an important role in their continued evolution – strengthening operational and financial performance while building the foundations for safe, sustainable and person-centred services into the future.

Scope offers flexible working arrangements, with the role based at an Australian Scope site and an expectation of a minimum of three days per week in a Scope location. Sector-comparable remuneration, NFP salary packaging and free onsite accessible parking are also available.

To view the Success Profile for this opportunity, please copy and paste the following link into your browser: https://tinyurl.com/yc3pmmdk

To apply for this role, please click the ‘apply now’ button and upload your cover letter and resume. Applications close COB Monday 5th October 2026. Should you require assistance in your interactions with us or through a recruitment process, please let us know so we can provide adjustments for you.

For a confidential discussion contact: Danielle Walker at Danielle.Walker@davidsonwp.com or 0402 278 870 or Paul Lefebvre at Paul.Lefebvre@davidsonwp.com or 0408 036 046 from Davidson Executive & Talent.

Davidson acknowledges the Traditional Custodians of the lands on which we work and live. We are committed to equal opportunity and strive to promote diversity, inclusion, belonging, flexibility, and accessibility in all that we do.

job.title: Organisational Change Manager
job.description:
About the Company

Our client is a large, complex public sector organisation delivering essential services to communities across Queensland.

Operating within a highly regulated and diverse environment, the organisation delivers enterprise-wide corporate, workforce and technology initiatives that support effective service delivery. Its programs involve complex transformation and change, requiring close collaboration across multiple business functions and stakeholder groups.


About the Role

As an Organisational Change Manager, you will provide specialist leadership across the full organisational change lifecycle, from strategic analysis and detailed business case development through implementation, transition and benefits realisation.

You will lead the development of robust business cases and implementation plans for complex change initiatives, ensuring proposed changes are evidence-based, well governed, operationally feasible and aligned with organisational requirements.

  • Developing detailed business cases covering current and future state, options, risks, costs, benefits and implementation considerations
  • Preparing executive briefs, governance papers, decision papers and supporting documentation
  • Designing implementation approaches covering workstreams, milestones, dependencies, governance, resourcing and timeframes
  • Leading organisational change through implementation, transition and embedding
  • Providing specialist advice on organisational design, workforce impacts and transition planning
  • Assessing impacts across structures, roles, functions and ways of working and developing practical mitigation strategies
  • Leading stakeholder engagement, consultation and communication to support decision-making, readiness and adoption
  • Working closely with HR, industrial relations, finance, legal, ICT and business leaders
  • Ensuring change activities address relevant workforce, HR and industrial relations obligations
  • Establishing governance, reporting, risk and issue management processes
  • Monitoring progress, managing emerging issues and supporting benefits realisation
  • Providing senior leaders and governance bodies with clear, timely strategic advice


About You

You are an experienced organisational change professional who can move confidently between strategic thinking, detailed analysis and practical delivery.

  • Demonstrated experience developing detailed business cases and implementation plans for complex organisational change
  • Proven capability managing change end to end, from strategic analysis through implementation and transition
  • Strong expertise in organisational change, organisational design, workforce transition and implementation planning
  • Sound knowledge of HR, industrial relations and workforce compliance considerations
  • Experience working with industrial instruments, consultation obligations and employment frameworks
  • Strong written communication skills, with experience preparing executive and governance documentation
  • Strong project and programme delivery capability, including planning, dependencies, risk management and reporting
  • Highly developed stakeholder engagement, negotiation and influencing skills
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and judgement skills, with the ability to translate strategy into practical delivery

Relevant tertiary qualifications in business, human resources, organisational psychology, public administration, management or a related discipline are required. Qualifications or certification in change, project or programme management will be highly regarded. You will also demonstrate accountability for outcomes, a commitment to continuous growth, the ability to build productive working relationships and sound judgement in complex environments.


The Benefits

This is an opportunity to contribute to significant organisational change within a large and complex public sector environment and play a key role in shaping how major initiatives are planned, delivered and embedded.

You will work across a broad stakeholder environment and have the opportunity to influence significant organisational outcomes through strong change leadership, practical implementation planning and evidence-based advice.

The role offers the opportunity to work within a values-led environment focused on service delivery, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.

Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Natalee Thorpe (natalee.thorpe@davidsonwp.com) quoting reference JN-092026-44253.

To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Workplace Relations Manager
job.description:
Senior workplace relations leadership opportunity

Complex, multi-entity and purpose-led organisation

NFP benefits | Brisbane

Davidson is partnering with a significant human and social services organisation to appoint a Workplace Relations Manager to lead its workplace and industrial relations agenda across a diverse and complex operating environment.

This is an influential opportunity for an accomplished workplace relations professional who combines deep technical expertise with commercial judgement and the ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments.

As the organisation's senior subject matter expert, you will partner with executives and leaders to shape workplace relations strategy, manage risk and provide pragmatic advice across complex employee and industrial matters.

The opportunity

You will:

  • Lead workplace and industrial relations strategy across a complex, multi-entity organisation.
  • Provide expert advice to executives and senior leaders on complex and sensitive matters.
  • Lead enterprise bargaining, union negotiations and consultation.
  • Manage significant ER/IR matters, disputes and complex investigations.
  • Represent and support the organisation in Fair Work Commission proceedings and industrial disputes.
  • Advise on organisational change, transformation and associated workforce risks.
  • Strengthen workplace relations governance, policies and frameworks.
  • Coach leaders and build organisational capability in effective workplace relations.

About you

You will be an established workplace relations, industrial relations or employment law professional with experience operating in a complex organisation.

Your background will ideally include:

  • Significant experience across workplace relations, industrial relations and complex employee relations.
  • Strong enterprise bargaining and union negotiation experience.
  • Experience managing complex disputes, investigations and sensitive workplace matters.
  • Strong knowledge of the Fair Work Act, modern awards and enterprise agreements.
  • Exposure to Fair Work Commission matters and other relevant tribunals.
  • The ability to provide commercially pragmatic advice and influence senior stakeholders.
  • Experience within a complex, multi-site, regulated or workforce-intensive environment.

Tertiary qualifications in law, human resources, employment relations, business or a related discipline will be highly regarded.

Why consider this opportunity?

This is an opportunity to take genuine ownership of workplace relations within a purpose-led organisation delivering essential services across Australia.

The complexity of the organisation and its workforce provides the opportunity to influence strategy while remaining close to sophisticated workplace relations matters.

The position offers attractive not-for-profit salary packaging benefits and flexible working arrangements.

Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact George Hall on +61 0468341514, quoting reference JN -092026-44263. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Agile Delivery Lead
job.description:
About the Company

Davidson has partnered with Barwon Water to appoint an Agile Delivery Lead to play a pivotal role in driving the successful delivery of strategic technology and transformation initiatives across the organisation.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Agile Delivery Lead to drive a business-wide Agile capability uplift program. This is not a traditional Scrum Master role. We are looking for someone who can operate as an Agile coach and delivery lead, embedding Agile ways of working across the organisation while remaining hands-on in delivery.

Key responsibilities:

  • Lead the Agile capability uplift initiative across multiple business and technology teams.
  • Define, implement, and continuously improve Agile ways of working aligned to organisational objectives.
  • Coach delivery teams, Product Owners, managers, and stakeholders on Agile principles and practices.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies and delivery governance where required.
  • Drive Agile adoption, maturity assessments, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with senior stakeholders to establish scalable delivery frameworks and operating models.
  • Design, build, and optimise Jira workflows, dashboards, reporting structures, and metrics.
  • Consolidate and integrate reporting across Jira, Power BI, and existing presentation/reporting processes.
  • Develop meaningful delivery insights and portfolio reporting to support leadership decision-making.
  • Support teams in planning, prioritisation, dependency management, and delivery execution.
  • Champion a culture of collaboration, transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement.

About You

You are a pragmatic Agile practitioner who can balance coaching, change leadership, and hands-on delivery execution. You have successfully helped organisations embed Agile practices beyond individual teams and understand how to drive sustainable adoption.

Relevant skills & experience:

  • Demonstrated experience leading Agile transformations, capability uplift programs, or organisational Agile adoption initiatives.
  • Strong experience as an Agile Delivery Lead, Agile Coach, Delivery Manager, or similar role.
  • Deep understanding of Agile frameworks including Scrum, Kanban, Lean, and scaled delivery approaches.
  • Advanced Jira experience
  • Experience building delivery reporting and executive dashboards.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills across business and technology functions.
  • Proven ability to coach teams while remaining hands-on in delivery activities.
  • Excellent facilitation, communication, and change management skills.
  • Experience delivering Agile transformations in large enterprise environments.
  • Experience with Power BI reporting and data visualisation.
  • Exposure to portfolio management, PMO functions, or enterprise delivery frameworks.
  • Relevant Agile certifications (SAFe, Certified Scrum Professional, ICAgile, Scrum Master, etc.).

The Benefits

This is an opportunity to join an organisation undertaking one of regional Victoria's most significant transformation agendas while playing a key leadership role in shaping delivery capability and performance. You'll work closely with senior leaders, product teams, technology specialists and delivery partners while contributing to initiatives that will create lasting value for Barwon Water and the communities it serves.




Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Maaz Mian on Maaz.Mian@Davidsonwp.com, quoting reference JN -092026-44229. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Principal Spatial Administrator
job.description:
Initial contract til March 2027

Hybrid working with 2-3 days onsite in Strathpine

$62p/h + Superannuation


The Opportunity

Join a large, complex local government environment as a Principal Spatial Administrator, taking ownership of the day-to-day management, optimisation and integrity of an enterprise Geographic Information System. This is a hands-on senior technical role suited to an experienced GIS professional with deep ESRI ArcGIS expertise who can manage enterprise platforms, spatial databases and web delivery systems while providing technical leadership across complex GIS matters.


About the Role

This position will sit within the Enterprise Applications team and provide senior technical oversight across the organisation's GIS environment.

  • Manage and optimise enterprise GIS platforms and spatial data.
  • Install, configure and maintain GIS platforms, web portals and mobile mapping applications.
  • Monitor GIS system performance, health, backups and security and resolve complex issues.
  • Maintain spatial data integrity, metadata, database design, quality standards and controls.
  • Deliver advanced spatial analysis, modelling, reporting and data visualisation.
  • Identify and implement GIS enhancements and continuously improve spatial services.


About You

You will be a technically strong GIS professional with substantial enterprise administration experience rather than someone whose background is primarily spatial analysis or mapping.

  • Expert knowledge of ESRI ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise and ArcGIS Online.
  • Strong practical experience with FME in enterprise GIS environments.
  • Experience managing GIS databases, spatial data and web delivery systems.
  • Strong scripting/programming capability across Python, SQL and/or Arcade.
  • Advanced knowledge of spatial analysis, data modelling, cartography and visualisation.
  • Strong troubleshooting, stakeholder engagement and competing-priority management skills.

A relevant degree in Geographic Information Science, Computer Science, Information Management or a related discipline is desirable, although equivalent relevant experience will be considered.


The Benefits
This opportunity offers the chance to take genuine technical ownership within a substantial enterprise GIS environment.

  • Senior, hands-on role with ownership across an enterprise GIS ecosystem.
  • Work across ESRI, FME, spatial databases, web GIS and automation.
  • Contribute to the ongoing improvement and evolution of enterprise spatial services.


How to Apply
Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Nina Magill on nina.magill@davidsonwp.com, quoting reference JN -092026-44262. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

job.title: Business Analyst – Superannuation & Policy Administration
job.description:
JOB OVERVIEW:

Business Analyst – Superannuation & Policy Administration

Location: Sydney – Hybrid schedule

Contract: 6-month contract with potential for extension

Industry: Life Insurance / Superannuation

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst to join a technology transformation program within the Life Insurance and Superannuation space. This role will suit a senior, techno-functional BA with strong experience working across mainframe or legacy applications, ideally within insurance or superannuation environments.

You will play a key role across the discovery, analysis, elaboration, testing and implementation lifecycle, translating business and customer requirements into high-quality user stories, process documentation and acceptance criteria.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as a subject matter expert and key contact for client issues, change requests and system/process improvements.
  • Analyse existing business processes and applications to identify opportunities for transformation, improved customer service, cost reduction and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with Technology, Administration, Product, Legal and other stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver effective solutions.
  • Facilitate and participate in business and technical workshops to investigate problems and elaborate requirements.
  • Develop and maintain business requirements, process design documentation and supporting artefacts throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Translate business requirements into well-defined user stories and initial acceptance criteria.
  • Work with delivery teams to prioritise features and support sprint planning and story elaboration within an Agile environment.
  • Identify business, commercial and technical risks, issues and dependencies and support appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Develop, refine and execute test cases as part of User Acceptance Testing.
  • Support system deployments, implementation activities, release management and change initiatives.
  • Develop change management and stakeholder communication plans, including implementation and training documentation.
  • Provide regular progress reporting, highlighting risks, issues and exceptions.
  • Support post-implementation reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Assist operational teams with system/process issues and incidents impacting platform technology and users.
  • Contribute to the development of team capability by sharing knowledge, reviewing documentation and supporting other team members.

About You

  • Strong experience as a Business Analyst, ideally in a senior or techno-functional capacity.
  • Experience within the Life Insurance and/or Superannuation industry.
  • Demonstrated experience working with mainframe or legacy applications.
  • Experience with L400 / Life400 or similar mainframe-based administration systems would be highly desirable.
  • Strong business process analysis, requirements elicitation and problem-solving skills.

job.title: Recruitment Consultant
job.description:
You’ve learned how to recruit. You know how to build a market, develop relationships, win work and deliver results.

But maybe you’ve started wondering whether there should be more to this career than the next vacancy, placement and fee.

We think there should be.

Recruitment is where the conversation starts.


At Davidson, a vacancy might simply mean a client needs a great person. That’s our bread and butter and something we’re proud to do well.

But sometimes there’s a bigger problem.

Why can’t they attract the people they need? Why are good people leaving? Is it capability, culture, process, structure or technology?

Being part of a broader Davidson business spanning Executive & Talent, Strategy & Performance and Technology Consulting means you can ask better questions, bring other expertise into the conversation and build deeper client relationships.

We’re a large, privately owned Australian business with more than 35 years behind us.

We have scale, but we don’t want bureaucracy. Our consultants build markets, create industry events, develop communities and bring new ideas into the business.

  • You’ll get plenty of autonomy here. But autonomy comes with accountability.
  • We have KPIs. We have targets. We expect you to work hard, win business and deliver.
  • We just don’t believe good recruiters need to be told exactly how to do it.

Davidson isn’t for every recruiter.

If you need someone structuring your day, you may find the freedom uncomfortable.

If you don’t like change, you’ll probably find us frustrating.

And if you’re a great individual performer but your success comes at the expense of the team, this definitely isn’t the place.

We like high achievers. We just like humble ones.

We work hard. We challenge each other. We celebrate together. And when things get tough, we look after each other.


Davidson is entering its next chapter, and there’s plenty still to build.

So we’re looking for experienced recruiters who don’t necessarily want to leave recruitment. They just want to see how much further they can take it.

If that sounds like you, contact us, ask us the difficult questions.

Decide for yourself whether Davidson could be right for you.


Please submit your current resume to apply. If you'd like a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Michael Donnelly at michael.donnelly@davidsonwp.com, quoting reference JN -092026-44257. To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

Some specific responsibilities include:

· Provide coaching and practical guidance to leaders and workers on assurance processes, risk management and critical control verification.

· Participate in contractor prequalification, mobilisation and contractor assurance activities to verify compliance with contractual and legislative requirements.

· Support the preparation of management review reports, assurance summaries and performance dashboards.

About You

To be successful in this role you will have relevant qualifications and strong experience in health, safety and environment in large, complex renewable energy, construction, mining, oil and gas or similar industry. Additional qualifications in auditing, assurance, incident investigation and risk management will also be highly regarded.

job.title: Data Architect
job.description:
Melbourne CBD | Competitive Daily Rate | 12-Month Contract

Our client, a major organisation within the utilities sector, is seeking an experienced Data Architect for an initial 12-month contract to play a key role within a significant Billing Replacement Program.

The program is currently in Discovery and will replace existing billing platforms across a complex technology environment. This role will be responsible for establishing the current-state data baseline, defining target and interim data architectures, and guiding the migration and data assurance activities required throughout the transformation.

This isn't purely a data modelling or governance role. We're looking for someone who can operate across architecture, data migration and delivery – Someone comfortable understanding complex legacy data environments, identifying quality and lineage issues, and establishing the architecture required to successfully transition data into new platforms.

Your responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

· Assess the current data landscape, including models, flows, mappings, reports, data quality, ownership, lineage and systems of record.
· Define business data domains, key data objects, relationships, conceptual and logical models, ownership and mastership arrangements.
· Design target and interim data architectures aligned with enterprise, security, privacy, records management and operational requirements.
· Define the migration architecture across extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, archival, cutover and rollback.
· Align data contracts, APIs, event payloads, reporting, analytics and downstream data requirements with solution and integration architects.
· Work closely with business SMEs, architects, system leads, security teams and technology vendors to resolve data issues and support architecture decisions.

Skills and experience – To be successful in this role, you will bring:

· Strong capability across conceptual and logical data modelling, data domains, master data, metadata, lineage, data quality and governance.
· Strong data migration architecture experience, with an understanding of profiling, cleansing, transformation, reconciliation, cutover and legacy data considerations.
· Ability to translate complex business processes into practical data requirements, models, controls and implementation guidance.

Nice to haves:

· Utilities or energy industry experience, particularly across billing, customer, account, metering, service order or Australian energy market data.
· Experience with SAP IS-U or similar utility/customer platforms, including phased migration or dual-run environments.

This is an initial 12-month contract, based in Melbourne CBD, offering the opportunity to play a key architecture role within a major enterprise billing transformation.

You'll have the opportunity to shape the data architecture from Discovery, establishing the models, migration approach, governance and data foundations that will support the program through design and implementation.

How to Apply

job.title: ERP Program Master Scheduler
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced ERP Program Master Scheduler to join a significant and complex ERP transformation programme in Brisbane.

In this senior programme scheduling and controls role, you’ll establish and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) that brings the programme together.

You’ll work across multiple workstreams, vendors, delivery teams and business stakeholders. Your role is to provide a clear, reliable view of sequencing, milestones, dependencies, critical path and schedule risk.

This is more than schedule administration. You’ll use schedule data to identify emerging risks, test assumptions and give programme leaders the insight they need to make informed decisions.

The role

You will:

  • Develop, maintain and continuously improve the programme Integrated Master Schedule.
  • Bring workstream, vendor and project schedules into one integrated programme view.
  • Manage dependencies across business, technology, vendors and delivery workstreams.
  • Maintain clear visibility of critical path activities, constraints, milestones and key decision points.
  • Analyse schedule performance against approved baselines, identifying emerging risks and variances early.
  • Undertake scenario modelling and schedule impact analysis to support recovery planning and replanning.
  • Coordinate sequencing across design, build, integration, data migration, testing, change, deployment, cutover, hypercare and business readiness.
  • Facilitate schedule reviews, planning workshops and cross-programme dependency discussions.
  • Work closely with project managers, workstream leads, vendors and delivery partners to maintain accurate and credible plans.
  • Constructively challenge unrealistic timelines, assumptions, milestones and incomplete schedule inputs.
  • Maintain schedule change control and clear records of assumptions, constraints and dependencies.
  • Produce forward-look schedules, schedule confidence reporting and governance-ready insights.
  • Turn complex scheduling information into clear recommendations for senior programme and executive stakeholders.
  • Establish practical scheduling standards that strengthen planning discipline across the programme.

About you

You’ll bring senior-level master scheduling or programme controls experience from a large-scale ERP or complex ICT transformation.

You understand that a credible master schedule does more than track activity. It helps leaders see where delivery is under pressure, understand the impact of change and make better-informed decisions.

We’re looking for experience in:

  • Designing and managing an Integrated Master Schedule.
  • End-to-end ERP or enterprise transformation delivery.
  • Major ERP platforms such as SAP, Oracle, TechnologyOne or equivalent.
  • Critical Path Method (CPM), schedule baselining, variance analysis, dependency management and schedule risk.
  • Enterprise scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project and/or Primavera P6.
  • Integrating schedules across multiple projects, workstreams and third-party vendors.
  • Formal programme governance and assurance environments.
  • Analysing schedule data to identify risks, impacts and implications.
  • Influencing senior stakeholders and constructively challenging delivery assumptions without direct authority.
  • Communicating complex schedule issues as clear, concise insights for senior leaders.
  • Agile, PRINCE2, PMBoK or hybrid delivery environments.

Experience in the public sector or another highly regulated environment will be advantageous.

Why consider this opportunity?

You’ll take a central role in a major transformation where the quality of the Integrated Master Schedule directly supports planning, governance and delivery decisions.

You’ll have visibility across the transformation lifecycle and work closely with programme leadership, delivery teams and vendors.

It’s an opportunity to bring structure to a complex delivery environment, surface risks early and help leaders make decisions with greater clarity and confidence.

If you’re an experienced Master Scheduler with strong ERP or enterprise transformation experience, we’d welcome your application.

Please submit your current resume to apply.

For a confidential discussion about the role, contact Amanda Aing via amanda.aing@davidsonwp.com, quoting reference JN-092026-44182.

To learn more about Davidson, visit davidsonwp.com.

  • Develop and quality assure project notifications, community updates, consultation materials, stakeholder briefings and other communications.
  • Provide strategic advice on stakeholder engagement, emerging issues and reputational risks.
  • Proactively identify and help mitigate community and stakeholder risks associated with project delivery.
  • Translate complex engineering, technical and construction information into clear and accessible public messaging.
  • Manage sensitive stakeholder matters, enquiries and competing priorities with sound judgement.
  • Monitor community sentiment and stakeholder feedback to help inform project decision-making.
  • Represent the project at stakeholder, contractor and community meetings as required.

About You
You will be an experienced communications and stakeholder engagement professional who is confident operating in complex project and construction environments.

We are particularly interested in hearing from candidates with experience across transport infrastructure, civil construction, major projects, alliances, joint ventures or contractor-delivered projects.

To be successful, you will ideally bring:

  • Demonstrated experience delivering communications and stakeholder engagement for major infrastructure or construction projects.
  • Strong exposure to active construction and project delivery, including communicating construction impacts, traffic changes or disruptions.
  • Experience working alongside principal contractors, alliance partners, engineering teams or multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Strong stakeholder relationship management skills and the confidence to influence and advise at senior levels.
  • Experience managing community concerns, complaints, sensitive issues and stakeholder risks.
  • Excellent written communication skills, including the ability to turn complex technical information into clear public messaging.
  • Experience developing communications and engagement strategies, project updates, notifications, briefings and consultation materials.
  • The ability to operate independently, exercise sound judgement and manage competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.
  • A proactive and solutions-focused approach to stakeholder and community engagement.

Previous Queensland Government or transport infrastructure experience will be highly regarded but is not essential.

IAP2 certification or tertiary qualifications in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, Stakeholder Engagement or a related discipline will also be viewed favourably.

The Benefits

  • Long-term 5 year contract through
  • $79.18 – $84.55 per hour + superannuation, dependent on experience and approved classification.
  • Work on significant, high-profile transport infrastructure projects on the Sunshine Coast.
  • Opportunity to work directly alongside government, contractors and multidisciplinary project delivery teams.
  • A genuinely hands-on role where your work will directly influence the stakeholder and community experience of major project delivery.
  • Buderim / Sunshine Coast location.


Please apply with your current resume in Microsoft Word format only (.doc or .docx.) For further information about Davidson and the opportunities we recruit across Australia, visit www.davidsonwp.com.

job.title: AO3 Project Support Officer - Sunshine Coast
job.description:
About the Company

Davidson is partnering with a Queensland Government organisation responsible for delivering significant transport infrastructure projects across the Sunshine Coast.

This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to two major projects while building your experience within a high-profile government infrastructure environment.

About the Role

As the AO3 Project Support Officer, you will provide day-to-day administrative, coordination and project support to Project Managers and broader project teams.

Working closely with internal stakeholders, you will help maintain effective project governance by ensuring documentation, reporting and administrative processes are accurate, organised and completed on time.

  • Managing project documentation, filing, version control and document registers.
  • Coordinating document submissions, approvals, revisions and associated workflows.
  • Maintaining electronic document management systems, including SharePoint, InEight, DMS or similar platforms.
  • Establishing and maintaining project registers, correspondence logs and administrative systems.
  • Coordinating meetings and preparing agendas, supporting documentation and minutes.
  • Providing administrative support to Project Managers and broader project teams.
  • Maintaining spreadsheets and assisting with basic project reporting.
  • Liaising with internal stakeholders to obtain and clarify project information.
  • Preparing project correspondence using Microsoft Office applications.
  • Supporting records management, data entry, filing and general project administration.
  • Ensuring documentation and administrative processes comply with quality and records management requirements.

About You

You will be an organised and detail-focused administration professional who can confidently manage competing priorities within a busy project environment.

  • Previous experience in project administration, project support or a similar administrative position.
  • Strong document control and records management experience.
  • Experience using SharePoint, electronic document management systems or comparable platforms.
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills, particularly Word and Excel.
  • Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence engaging with stakeholders at varying levels.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Experience within Queensland Government, transport or major infrastructure projects will be highly regarded.

A current Class C driver’s licence is desirable.

The Benefits

  • Competitive rate of $51.13 - $56.72 per hour + super per hour plus superannuation.
  • Initial 2 year contract with potential for extesion
  • AO3 opportunity within a Queensland Government organisation.
  • Contribute to two significant transport infrastructure projects.
  • Gain valuable exposure to project delivery, governance and document control.
  • Convenient Maroochydore, Sunshine Coast location.
  • Work across varied project administration and stakeholder coordination activities.
  • The successful candidate will be required to complete a criminal history check before appointment.
